contract.aggregation_rule: Never pool sources into one universal accuracy. Report task/source strata and denominators.

metrics.authored_wanli: Hard-label accuracy, balanced accuracy, NLL/Brier, source-group intervals; populations separate.
metrics.every: Author-label agreement for154 nodes, retrieval Recall@1/3 and MRR, ten frozen composed firewall actions.
metrics.speed: Complete wall time, decisions/s, per-state latency and peak VRAM on one RTX3090; model load excluded.
metrics.stability: Argmax flip rate and absolute probability movement under predeclared perturbations.
metrics.typesafe: Equal-case agreement and probability distance to released model-reference mean; not human accuracy.

limitations: All gold rows count in accuracy, including missing/invalid/unparsed predictions.
Native decisions have no probability estimates; one-hot distributions are not fabricated.
Risk/coverage is descriptive; tied confidence values remain together.
Analytic event hard-label accuracy measures modal-class agreement, not observed-event accuracy.
